author: Carlos Martinez
title: iRacing at the Nordschleife: Clips From the Ring
description: Short iRacing clips from the Nürburgring Nordschleife: starts, GT cars, forest corners and rain, filmed in a racing simulator.

sections.p: This is iRacing, a racing simulator. It is not real life. All of the clips below come from the sim, except one that shows sim rigs at the real Nürburgring.
They were filmed at the Nürburgring, mostly on the Nordschleife. You will see GT3 and GT4 cars, starts, forest corners and some rain.

list: Starts: the lights turn green on the BMW M4 GT4 EVO start straight, and a rolling start behind a pale-grey Porsche GT3 car.
Following cars: an orange-and-blue McLaren GT4 under the Bilstein gantry, and a red Porsche GT3 car through the kerbs and armco.
Close racing in the forest: a blue, white and orange Porsche GT3 car and a lime-green car run close together.
Rain from a Porsche cockpit: mist over the forest, wet corners, yellow tents and grey mist over the grandstands.
Quiet onboard runs in the BMW M4 GT4 EVO through the forest sections with the guardrail close.
Down the pit lane at the pit speed limit behind a yellow car, with the grandstands and a Mercedes logo ahead.
Sim rigs at the real Nürburgring, and the onboard replay of a lap on the TV that night.

sections.p: The Nordschleife is the old north loop of the Nurburgring in Germany. Its lap is 20.832 km. The Nürburgring also has a 5.1 km Grand Prix track. I also filmed the real place from a car in heavy rain: the Nordschleife in heavy rain.

faqs.a: No. These clips are from iRacing, a racing simulator. One clip shows sim rigs at the real Nürburgring in Germany.
The Nordschleife lap is 20.832 km. It is the old north loop of the Nurburgring in Germany.

faqs.q: Which cars are in the clips?
faqs.a: You can see BMW M4 GT4 and GT4 EVO cars, Porsche GT3 cars, an orange-and-blue McLaren GT4 and a white GT3 car with red stripes.
